مَحْبُوكٌ : see حَبِيكٌ. ―
-b2- [Hence,] A strong horse; (K;) firm, or compact, in make: (TA:) or strong in make; applied to a horse &c. (S.) And دَابَّةٌ مَحْبُوكَةٌ A beast having a well-knit frame. (Sh, TA.) And مَحْبُوكُ المَتْنِ وَ العَجُزِ Even, and high, in the back and rump. (Lth, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
